title: Top Treadmills for Small Spaces & Home Gyms (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the provided sources (NordicTrack X24, X16, Echelon Stride 6, Commercial 2950).
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a busy parent who wants a treadmill that fits a tight living room and still offers a full workout. The X24 has a 22‑inch touchscreen, a large running belt, and iFit integration, making it the most feature‑rich option for those who need variety and convenience. The catch: it is the largest of the four, so it may not fit the smallest rooms.
